name: codex-monitor
description: Local Codex turn/session tokens including compaction, tool calls, and estimated weekly quota by reset cycle.

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex context and token usage in-window.
interface.longDescription: A local, read-only Codex monitor for the current ChatGPT desktop app and legacy Codex Desktop. It reads session logs and injects a temporary overlay, sidebar hover panel, and per-response token chips through Chrome DevTools Protocol.
defaultPrompt: Show my latest Codex token usage.
